title: BilingualSearch
description: Search the creative inventory in both your game language and English.
body:
# Bilingual Search

Search the creative inventory and recipe book in **both your game language and English** — no matter what language you play in.

## Features

- Type **anvil** and find 金床 — or type **金床** and find it just the same
- Works in both the **creative inventory search** and the **survival recipe book**
- Works with **any language**: the mod always loads English + your current game language
- **No configuration needed** — just install and search

## How It Works

Minecraft's built-in search only matches the language your game is set to. This mod adds a second pass after every search, checking English item names from `en_us.json` so you can search in either language freely.

This applies to:
- **Creative inventory** — find any item by its English or local name
- **Recipe book** — find any recipe by the English or local name of its output item

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21+
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
